scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:front && corepack pnpm run build:admin
scripts.watch: corepack pnpm run watch:front:dev & corepack pnpm run watch:admin:dev & wait
scripts.watch:front:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING=true wp-scripts build --watch --config webpack.front.js
scripts.watch:admin:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING=true wp-scripts build --watch --config webpack.admin.js
